	# a stable building_type -> goods market scope combination.

	# Shared CMM price gates are applied by the common candidate checks.
	always = yes

eu5ab_luxury_goods_has_budget = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.var:eu5ab_global_budget_remaining >= building_base_cost_in_gold

	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.gold >= eu5ab_cash_required_luxury_goods
}

eu5ab_template_slot_1_has_input_materials = {
	# The shared CMM shortage gate is applied by the common candidate checks.
	always = yes
}

eu5ab_template_slot_1_price_in_range = {
	# Shared CMM price gates are applied by the common candidate checks.
	always = yes
}

eu5ab_template_slot_1_keeps_cash_reserve = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.gold >= eu5ab_cash_required_template_slot_1
}

eu5ab_template_slot_1_has_budget = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.var:eu5ab_global_budget_remaining >= building_base_cost_in_gold
}

eu5ab_template_slot_2_building_allowed = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner = {
		has_variable_map = eu5ab_tpl_2_building_priorities
		is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_tpl_2_building_priorities target = prev }
	}
}

eu5ab_template_slot_6_has_input_materials = {
	# The shared CMM shortage gate is applied by the common candidate checks.
	always = yes
}

eu5ab_template_slot_6_price_in_range = {
	# Shared CMM price gates are applied by the common candidate checks.
	always = yes
}

eu5ab_template_slot_6_keeps_cash_reserve = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.gold >= eu5ab_cash_required_template_slot_6
}

eu5ab_template_slot_6_has_budget = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.var:eu5ab_global_budget_remaining >= building_base_cost_in_gold
}

eu5ab_template_slot_7_building_allowed = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner = {
		has_variable_map = eu5ab_tpl_7_building_priorities
		is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_tpl_7_building_priorities target = prev }
	}
}

eu5ab_template_slot_11_has_input_materials = {
	# The shared CMM shortage gate is applied by the common candidate checks.
	always = yes
}

eu5ab_template_slot_11_price_in_range = {
	# Shared CMM price gates are applied by the common candidate checks.
	always = yes
}

eu5ab_template_slot_11_keeps_cash_reserve = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.gold >= eu5ab_cash_required_template_slot_11
}

eu5ab_template_slot_11_has_budget = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.var:eu5ab_global_budget_remaining >= building_base_cost_in_gold
}

eu5ab_template_slot_12_building_allowed = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner = {
		has_variable_map = eu5ab_tpl_12_building_priorities
		is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_tpl_12_building_priorities target = prev }
	}
}

eu5ab_template_slot_12_special_building_allowed = {
	OR = {
		scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.var:eu5ab_global_allow_special_buildings > 0
		NOT = {
			OR = {
				this = building_type:academy_of_sciences
				this = building_type:alhambra
				this = building_type:bajang_ratu
				this = building_type:banking_office
				this = building_type:bardic_school
				this = building_type:brethren_marsh
				this = building_type:bubu_building
				this = building_type:bund
				this = building_type:calmecac

	# The shared CMM shortage gate is applied by the common candidate checks.
	always = yes
}

eu5ab_template_slot_12_price_in_range = {
	# Shared CMM price gates are applied by the common candidate checks.
	always = yes
}

eu5ab_template_slot_12_keeps_cash_reserve = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.gold >= eu5ab_cash_required_template_slot_12
}

eu5ab_template_slot_12_has_budget = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.var:eu5ab_global_budget_remaining >= building_base_cost_in_gold
}

eu5ab_template_slot_13_building_allowed = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner = {
		has_variable_map = eu5ab_tpl_13_building_priorities
		is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_tpl_13_building_priorities target = prev }
	}
}

eu5ab_template_slot_17_has_input_materials = {
	# The shared CMM shortage gate is applied by the common candidate checks.
	always = yes
}

eu5ab_template_slot_17_price_in_range = {
	# Shared CMM price gates are applied by the common candidate checks.
	always = yes
}

eu5ab_template_slot_17_keeps_cash_reserve = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.gold >= eu5ab_cash_required_template_slot_17
}

eu5ab_template_slot_17_has_budget = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.var:eu5ab_global_budget_remaining >= building_base_cost_in_gold
}

eu5ab_template_slot_18_building_allowed = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner = {
		has_variable_map = eu5ab_tpl_18_building_priorities
		is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_tpl_18_building_priorities target = prev }
	}
}

eu5ab_template_slot_20_has_input_materials = {
	# The shared CMM shortage gate is applied by the common candidate checks.
	always = yes
}

eu5ab_template_slot_20_price_in_range = {
	# Shared CMM price gates are applied by the common candidate checks.
	always = yes
}

eu5ab_template_slot_20_keeps_cash_reserve = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.gold >= eu5ab_cash_required_template_slot_20
}

eu5ab_template_slot_20_has_budget = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.var:eu5ab_global_budget_remaining >= building_base_cost_in_gold
}

# would cross the construction-stall headroom or an extreme price ceiling.

		limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_construction_demand_books > 0 }
		eu5ab_market_books_projected_construction_overage < 0
		market ?= {
			"market_price(goods:books)" <= {
				value = "default_price(goods:books)"
				multiply = 1.5
			}

# GUI-only actual values are passed as fixed-value scopes by the hidden bridge.
# Candidate classes are mutually exclusive: replacement upgrade, from-zero new build,
# or another level of an existing ordinary building.
eu5ab_candidate_is_upgrade = {
	eu5ab_candidate_replaces_existing_building = yes
}

eu5ab_candidate_is_new_build = {
	NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_replaces_existing_building = yes }
	OR = {
		AND = { this = building_type:academy_of_sciences scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:academy_of_sciences } } }
		AND = { this = building_type:admiralty scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:admiralty } } }

eu5ab_candidate_produces_food = {
	OR = {
		this = building_type:eng_royal_forest
		this = building_type:farming_village
		this = building_type:fishing_village
		this = building_type:fruit_orchard
		this = building_type:granary
		this = building_type:irrigation_systems
		this = building_type:windmill
	}
}

# The two existing food switches own both parts of emergency response:
# priority over non-food work and the ordinary-building return-metric bypass.
eu5ab_food_emergency_enabled = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			owner.var:eu5ab_global_emergency_food_exhaustion_override > 0
			market ?= { is_projected_to_run_out_of_food_stockpile = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			owner.var:eu5ab_global_emergency_food_stockpile_override > 0
			market ?= { market_food_percentage <= 0.25 }
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = {
	eu5ab_food_emergency_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		raw_material = goods:beeswax
		raw_material = goods:fish
		raw_material = goods:fruit
		raw_material = goods:fur
		raw_material = goods:legumes
		raw_material = goods:livestock
		raw_material = goods:maize
		raw_material = goods:millet
		raw_material = goods:olives
		raw_material = goods:potato
		raw_material = goods:rice
		raw_material = goods:wheat
		raw_material = goods:wild_game
	}
}

eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = {
	eu5ab_food_emergency_enabled = yes
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_produces_food = yes }
}

eu5ab_engine_candidate_feature_rank_1 = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_is_upgrade = yes }
			scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_upgrade = 1
		}
		AND = {
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_is_new_build = yes }
			scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_new = 1
		}
		AND = {
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_is_expansion = yes }
			scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_expand = 1
		}
	}
}

# Eight queue phases implement the exact four-feature order twice:
# food-emergency ranks 1-4 first, then normal ranks 1-4 as phases 5-8.
eu5ab_engine_candidate_in_current_priority_phase = {
	OR = {
		AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 1 eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes eu5ab_engine_candidate_feature_rank_1 = yes }
		AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 2 eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes eu5ab_engine_candidate_feature_rank_2 = yes }
		AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 3 eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes eu5ab_engine_candidate_feature_rank_3 = yes }
		AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 4 eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes eu5ab_engine_candidate_feature_rank_4 = yes }
		AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 5 NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes } eu5ab_engine_candidate_feature_rank_1 = yes }
		AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 6 NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes } eu5ab_engine_candidate_feature_rank_2 = yes }
		AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 7 NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes } eu5ab_engine_candidate_feature_rank_3 = yes }
		AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 8 NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes } eu5ab_engine_candidate_feature_rank_4 = yes }
	}
}

eu5ab_rgo_in_current_priority_phase = {
	OR = {
		AND = { owner.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 1 owner.var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_rgo = 1 eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes }
		AND = { owner.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 2 owner.var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_rgo = 2 eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes }
		AND = { owner.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 3 owner.var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_rgo = 3 eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes }
		AND = { owner.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 4 owner.var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_rgo = 4 eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes }
		AND = { owner.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 5 owner.var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_rgo = 1 NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes } }
		AND = { owner.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 6 owner.var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_rgo = 2 NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes } }
		AND = { owner.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 7 owner.var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_rgo = 3 NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes } }
		AND = { owner.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 8 owner.var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_rgo = 4 NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes } }
	}
}

eu5ab_engine_candidate_passes_selected_metric = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_global_economic_metric }
					var:eu5ab_global_economic_metric = 1
				}
			}
			scope:eu5ab_engine_income > 0
		}
		AND = {
			scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { var:eu5ab_global_economic_metric = 2 }
			scope:eu5ab_engine_profit > 0
		}
		AND = {
			scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { var:eu5ab_global_economic_metric = 3 }
			scope:eu5ab_engine_income >= {
				value = scope:eu5ab_engine_cost
				multiply = 0.05
				divide = 12
			}
		}
		AND = {
			scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { var:eu5ab_global_economic_metric = 4 }
			scope:eu5ab_engine_profit >= {
				value = scope:eu5ab_engine_cost
				multiply = 0.05
				divide = 12
			}
		}
	}
}

# Emergency demand is deliberately separate from candidate ranking. Each
# reason has its own CMM switch and can bypass only the selected return metric.
eu5ab_engine_candidate_uses_emergency_override = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_recipe_expected_output_value > 0
	NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_passes_selected_metric = yes }
	OR = {
		AND = {
			scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_global_emergency_food_exhaustion_override > 0
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = {
				OR = {
					this = building_type:eng_royal_forest
					this = building_type:farming_village
					this = building_type:fishing_village
					this = building_type:fruit_orchard
					this = building_type:granary
					this = building_type:irrigation_systems
					this = building_type:windmill
				}
			}
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.market ?= { is_projected_to_run_out_of_food_stockpile = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_global_emergency_food_stockpile_override > 0
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = {
				OR = {
					this = building_type:eng_royal_forest
					this = building_type:farming_village
					this = building_type:fishing_village
					this = building_type:fruit_orchard
					this = building_type:granary
					this = building_type:irrigation_systems
					this = building_type:windmill
				}
			}
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.market ?= { market_food_percentage <= 0.25 }
		}
		AND = {
			scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_global_emergency_construction_goods_override > 0
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = {
				OR = {
					this = building_type:glass_guild
					this = building_type:glass_mill
					this = building_type:glass_workshop
					this = building_type:glassworks
					this = building_type:rural_glassmaker
				}
			}
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.market ?= {
				"goods_supply_in_market(goods:glass)" < {
					value = "goods_demand_in_market(goods:glass)"
					multiply = 0.65
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_global_emergency_construction_goods_override > 0
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = {
				OR = {
					this = building_type:lumber_mill
				}
			}
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.market ?= {
				"goods_supply_in_market(goods:lumber)" < {
					value = "goods_demand_in_market(goods:lumber)"
					multiply = 0.65
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_global_emergency_construction_goods_override > 0
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = {
				OR = {
					this = building_type:mason
				}
			}
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.market ?= {
				"goods_supply_in_market(goods:masonry)" < {
					value = "goods_demand_in_market(goods:masonry)"
					multiply = 0.65
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_global_emergency_construction_goods_override > 0
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = {
				OR = {
					this = building_type:iron_foundry
					this = building_type:iron_mill
					this = building_type:market_village
					this = building_type:tatara
					this = building_type:tools_guild
					this = building_type:tools_workshop
				}
			}
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.market ?= {
				"goods_supply_in_market(goods:tools)" < {
					value = "goods_demand_in_market(goods:tools)"
					multiply = 0.65
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_global_emergency_wartime_military_override > 0
			scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { at_war = yes }
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = {
				OR = {
					this = building_type:cannon_foundry
					this = building_type:cannon_maker
					this = building_type:cannon_workshop
					this = building_type:cannons_factory
				}
			}
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.market ?= {
				"goods_supply_in_market(goods:cannons)" < {
					value = "goods_demand_in_market(goods:cannons)"
					multiply = 0.65
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_global_emergency_wartime_military_override > 0
			scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { at_war = yes }
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = {
				OR = {
					this = building_type:cloth_guild
					this = building_type:cloth_manufactory
					this = building_type:cloth_workshop
					this = building_type:rural_clothmaker
					this = building_type:textile_mill
				}
			}
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.market ?= {
				"goods_supply_in_market(goods:cloth)" < {
					value = "goods_demand_in_market(goods:cloth)"
					multiply = 0.65
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_global_emergency_wartime_military_override > 0
			scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { at_war = yes }
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = {
				OR = {
					this = building_type:firearms_factory
					this = building_type:firearms_manufactory
					this = building_type:gun_smith
					this = building_type:guns_workshop
					this = building_type:hand_cannon_guild
				}

eu5ab_engine_candidate_economically_sound = {
	scope:eu5ab_engine_cost > 0
	OR = {
		# Infrastructure without a production recipe has no comparable return metric.
		scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_recipe_expected_output_value <= 0
		eu5ab_engine_candidate_passes_selected_metric = yes
		eu5ab_engine_candidate_uses_emergency_override = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_engine_candidate_has_actual_budget = {
	owner = {
		var:eu5ab_global_budget_remaining >= {
			value = scope:eu5ab_engine_cost
			add = var:eu5ab_q_planned_budget
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_engine_candidate_keeps_actual_cash_reserve = {
	owner = {
		gold >= {
			value = scope:eu5ab_engine_cost
			add = var:eu5ab_q_planned_spend
			add = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_current_min_cash_reserve
		}
	}
}

# Static job demand is exact for the selected building type and upgrade.
# The forward gate adds vanilla promotion modifiers for the configured
# 0-96 month horizon and caps the result by eligible source populations.
eu5ab_candidate_current_workforce_sufficient = {
	OR = {
		eu5ab_candidate_net_new_jobs <= 0
		eu5ab_candidate_current_available_workers >= eu5ab_candidate_net_new_jobs
	}
}

eu5ab_candidate_projected_workforce_sufficient = {
	OR = {
		eu5ab_candidate_net_new_jobs <= 0
		eu5ab_candidate_projected_available_workers >= eu5ab_candidate_net_new_jobs
	}
}

# Cross-template safety gates.
eu5ab_has_local_workforce = {
	OR = {
		scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.var:eu5ab_global_pause_low_workforce <= 0
		eu5ab_candidate_projected_workforce_sufficient = yes
	}
}

# RGO gates are split so the monthly diagnostics can classify every
# deeply-scored location by its first blocking condition.
eu5ab_rgo_capacity_available = {
	is_full_expanded_rgo = no
}

eu5ab_rgo_location_available = {
	num_civil_constructions < 1
	NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_build_cooldown }
	OR = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown } owner = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_active } }
}

eu5ab_rgo_enabled = {
	owner.var:eu5ab_global_allow_rgo > 0
}

eu5ab_rgo_finance_available = {
	owner.gold >= eu5ab_rgo_cash_required
	owner.var:eu5ab_global_budget_remaining >= 100
	owner.var:eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick < { value = owner.var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota }
}

eu5ab_rgo_utilization_allowed = {
	rgo_workers >= {
		value = eu5ab_rgo_current_capacity
		multiply = { value = owner.var:eu5ab_global_rgo_min_utilization divide = 100 }
	}
}

# One RGO level always adds the vanilla rgo_level workforce demand.
# The strict gate evaluates that prospective level, not merely whether
# the currently built RGO is staffed.
eu5ab_rgo_projected_workforce_sufficient = {
	eu5ab_rgo_projected_available_workers >= eu5ab_rgo_jobs_per_expansion
}

eu5ab_rgo_workforce_allowed = {
	OR = {
		owner.var:eu5ab_global_pause_low_workforce <= 0
		eu5ab_rgo_projected_workforce_sufficient = yes
	}
}
